claims.claim: Runtime deterministically canonicalizes REPAIR changed_files from the original TASK root base to the accepted final HEAD before verification and persistence, independently of the structural Executor declaration and in stable ordering.
REPAIR mutation authority remains independently derived from failed_head_sha to final HEAD, preserving modification-scope, CODE_FIX, NO_CHANGE, HEAD, and clean-worktree gates.

Codex and Antigravity REPAIR contracts assign historical changed-files authority to Runtime while preserving narrow mutation, complete TASK claims, structural output, no verification evidence, and no-push semantics.

The implementation is limited to the REPAIR completion boundary, native REPAIR instructions, and focused regression coverage; PRIMARY and REMEDIATION behavior and all excluded authority boundaries remain unchanged.
